requirements: Provide GET /products and GET /products/{id} using immutable packaged data containing exactly p1 Notebook priced 12.5 and p2 Pen priced 2.0; list responses are JSON arrays and details contain id, name, and price.
External clients access the service over HTTPS.
Serve 200 requests per second for five minutes with 95th-percentile latency below 500 ms.
The service must remain available when one application VM stops; deploy at least two application VMs across two availability zones behind a load balancer.
Do not provision persistent application data storage.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker, expose GET /health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to AWS ap-northeast-2 with a monthly infrastructure budget of 400 USD. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
